title: Pistachio Kissed Malt Treats
description: A sweet and crunchy snack made with a Canadian twist, combining kissed and malty flavors with a delicious pistachio twist.
instructions: 2. In a large mixing bowl, cream together pistachio butter and malted milk powder.
3. Add kissed honey and Canadian maple syrup to the mixture and mix well.
4. Gradually add the bowl of rolled oats to the mixture and mix until a dough forms.
5. Roll out the dough into a sheet and cut into desired shapes.
6. Bake in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until lightly golden.
7. Allow the treats to cool before serving.
